name: Seeded and deliberately poor test cases for the M7 harness

change_history.change: First version (M7 step 4): 23 hand-written cases on Day 4 stories S09, S05, S01 and S03, 7 of them clean controls, plus 2 story-level seeds.

notes: Synthetic cases written in the style real teams produce, each with a known defect, so every harness finding on them is a known hit, miss or false alarm.
This file is also a valid harness cases file: python -m harness.check --stories datasets/testgen_golden.json --cases datasets/harness_seeded_cases.json
Score it with: python -m harness.seeded (add --no-judge for the free checks only).

expectations.cases: must_fire = checks that must appear on that case; control = a clean case on which no case-level warning or failure may appear (except those in tolerate); if_duplicate_then_caution = if the judge calls the case a duplicate, the calendar caution must be in the message.
expectations.story_level: a story-level finding that must appear (check, and text it must contain).
Stories come from datasets/testgen_golden.json v1.0 (Harbourlight Health). AML/KYC seeds are added in step 5.

test_cases.title: Receipt without the treatment date is not treated as itemised
preconditions: The receipt shows the treatment 'physiotherapy session' and the amount 45.00 but no treatment date.
steps: Submit the claim in the member portal with this receipt attached.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is routed to manual_review with reason code MISSING_RECEIPT and is not recommended for automatic approval.

test_cases.title: Claim supported only by a bank statement shows an error
preconditions: The only document is a bank statement showing a payment of 45.00 on 2026-06-15.
steps: Submit the claim in the member portal with the bank statement attached.
test_cases.expected_result: An appropriate error message is shown.

test_cases.title: Ninth GP visit claim in a policy year is declined at the annual limit
preconditions: 8 GP visits have already been paid in this policy year.
steps: Submit a claim for a further GP visit.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code ANNUAL_LIMIT_REACHED.
